function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock information.  
To see what time it’s currently in New York you could:

1. **Check your phone/computer** – most devices display world clocks if you add “New York” (Eastern Time Zone) to the list.  
2. **Search online** – typing “current time in New York” into Google will show the exact hour/minute right away.  
3. **Use a smart assistant** – asking Siri/Google Assistant/Alexa “what time is it in New York?” works instantly.  

If you let me know whether you’re looking at Eastern Standard Time (EST, UTC‑5) or Eastern Daylight Time (EDT, UTC‑4), I can tell you the offset relative to Coordinated Universal Time so you can convert from your own zone manually.
